assets.name: gothic-tiered-fountain-with-water-jets
assets.description: A gray green Gothic fountain with pointed architectural spire, tiered basins and curved blue water jets. Part of the Walters W.171 Fountain of Life set.

provenance.title: Fountain of life and the four rivers of paradise

extraction.prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. Isolate ONLY the complete original tiered FOUNTAIN, including the full fine central spire, original pointed architectural openings, both tiered basins, all original curved water jets and the water streams at the base. Remove BOTH background trees, every part of the blue decorated O, the flat gold field and all letters/rules. Clear true architectural window/arch openings and gaps between jet streams. Preserve original gray green masonry, worn opaque pale paint and source-visible gold detailing without restoring or brightening the original. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.
extraction.method: AI-assisted foreground extraction; transparent alpha retained, resolution capped to source region and transparent exterior trimmed.

transparent_cleanup.method: Clear alpha <= 2/255 only more than three native pixels from alpha > 8/255; clear hidden RGB at alpha zero. Real edge alpha and visible color retained.

review.notes: Inspected the complete native original and each light/dark export. Retained all selected source-visible tree trunks, foliage, fruit, fountain architecture and water jets, and complete foliate border strokes, alternating original paint and fine stem ends. Gold background and independent neighboring art removed; painted bodies remain opaque. Finite hand-drawn border branches are whole ornaments, with no invented repeat or corner atlas. The blue line-filler preserves both gold pips and the original right terminal; neighboring red panel is excluded. Native visible subject dimensions cap both axes, with no upscaling.
